items.title: Constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules are exactly the cokernels of maps between finite sums of extensions by zero of the constant sheaf
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma identifies the constructible sheaves of Lambda-modules on a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme with the cokernels of maps between finite sums of extensions by zero of the constant sheaf (statement lines 12411-12425). The proof (proof lines 12427-12468) uses the torsion-colimit lemma for one inclusion, reduces the other to a surjection onto a given constructible module obtained from the filtered-colimit description and the modules-on-sites representation, and invokes abelianness for the cokernel form and spectrality for the affineness refinement. H2: one reduction plus two standard inputs, written out.
